written.headline: Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
written.summary: The Dutch government announced it will resist the US proposed MATCH Act, which aims to restrict ASML Holding NV's sales and maintenance services in China. Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen stated that the Netherlands intends to prevent the bill from becoming law, calling the proposal a threat to Europe's most valuable company.

written.headline: Z.ai misses GLM-5.5 launch as US rules and distillation curbs hit China AI
written.summary: Z.ai missed the scheduled November release for its 3-trillion-parameter flagship model, GLM-5.5, due to US computing restrictions and anti-distillation measures. Rival Moonshot AI also warns that losing access to overseas computing power could double the interval between its major releases.

written.headline: SoftBank default risk hits 4-year high amid AI investment worries
written.summary: The cost of insuring SoftBank Group bonds against default rose to a four-year high as investors questioned whether its AI investments will become profitable fast enough to service its debts. SoftBank's five-year credit default swap spread widened by more than 20 basis points to 534.6 basis points, with its default probability at 34.8%.

written.headline: ASML CEO warns aggressive export controls will push China to build domestic tech
written.summary: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet argued that export controls should not completely cut off China, warning that such a strategy would backfire by accelerating domestic development. ASML holds a $520 billion de facto monopoly in making lithography machines for advanced AI chips.

written.headline: Thariq Shihipar joins OpenAI after leaving Anthropic
written.summary: Thariq Shihipar has joined OpenAI following his departure from Anthropic in October. Shihipar previously worked as a Member of Technical Staff on Anthropic's Claude Code team.
